subject: math
description: Derive cone volume from a matching cylinder, then solve cone volume problems using radius, diameter, height, and unit reasoning.
learningObjectives: Compare a cone with a cylinder that has the same base radius and height
Explain why a cone has one-third the volume of its matching cylinder
Use V = one-third pi r squared h to calculate cone volume
Identify radius, diameter, and height from diagrams and word problems
Avoid using diameter as radius when substituting into the formula
Label cone volume answers with cubic units
prerequisites: Find the area of a circle using A = pi r squared
Know that diameter is twice the radius
Multiply fractions, decimals, and whole numbers
